failure_patterns.pattern: unrequested_or_duplicate_operations: Added unrelated searches or proximity calls, or repeated an initial search instead of performing only the requested operation.

rejected_edits.content: Apply one same-domain filter with every active user constraint for that deliverable that the selected base does not already reflect, including criteria from earlier turns omitted by a broad initial search; save the exact result under a fresh relevant key and do not reapply criteria already reflected in the base.
rejected_edits.target: Apply only the new same-domain filter and save the update under a fresh relevant key.
